title: What the Jan. 6 Hearings Have Revealed So Far

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·朗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其背后文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在我那个黑胶唱片时代的夜店当DJ的时候，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每天晚上都要带上300件你最珍视的宝贝去工作，把DJ台变成一个充满50年历史精美文物的流动博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼出品的《重构者》吧。

sentences.en: From New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is A Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《今日日报》。

sentences.en: Today, the January 6th committee has now held three of its five scheduled hearings, laying out the case that Donald Trump was at the center of a plot to overturn the election.
sentences.zh: 今天，1月6日事件调查委员会已经完成了五场预定听证会中的三场，他们提出的论点是：唐纳德·特朗普是推翻选举阴谋的核心人物。

sentences.en: I spoke with my colleague, Luke Broadwater, about what we're learning from the hearings and whether they're breaking through.
sentences.zh: 我与我的同事卢克·布罗德沃特谈了谈我们从听证会中了解到的情况，以及这些听证会是否产生了影响。

sentences.en: It's Friday, June 17th.
sentences.zh: 今天是6月17日，星期五。

sentences.en: Luke, we've been talking to you about the January 6th committee since its creation a little less than a year ago.
sentences.zh: 卢克，自从1月6日委员会成立以来，不到一年时间里，我们一直在和你讨论这个话题。

sentences.en: And we've always understood its mission to be figuring out what caused the events of that day and who's responsible for it.
sentences.zh: 我们一直认为它的使命是查明那天事件的起因以及谁该为此负责。

sentences.en: So how do these televised hearings in particular fit into that mission?
sentences.zh: 那么，这些电视转播的听证会究竟是如何服务于这一使命的呢？

sentences.en: In the nearly a year since the January 6th committee began its work, it started doing dozens and then hundreds and then finally more than a thousand closed-door interviews.
sentences.zh: 在1月6日委员会开始工作近一年来，他们进行了几十次、几百次，最终超过一千次的闭门访谈。

sentences.en: These are secret interviews that no one ever had access to, the press couldn't go into, the public couldn't go into.
sentences.zh: 这些是秘密访谈，没有任何人能接触到，媒体进不去，公众也进不去。

sentences.en: And they included top Trump White House officials.
sentences.zh: 其中包括特朗普白宫的高级官员。

sentences.en: They included people that were rioters that day.
sentences.zh: 其中包括那天参与骚乱的人。

sentences.en: They included state officials and Department of Justice officials and the National Guard and everybody in between.
sentences.zh: 其中包括州政府官员、司法部官员、国民警卫队成员以及所有相关人员。

sentences.en: And so these hearings are the committee's chance to begin revealing its findings from all these interviews and from the more than 140,000 documents it obtained.
sentences.zh: 因此，这些听证会是委员会展示从这些访谈以及他们获得的超过14万份文件中所发现事实的机会。

sentences.en: And they're going to show that their investigation has concluded this all boils down to one man being at the center of it all.
sentences.zh: 他们将证明，调查结论指向这一切归根结底都是由一个人主导的。

sentences.en: And that man is Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 而那个人就是唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: But big picture, Luke, what's the purpose of doing that?
sentences.zh: 但从大局来看，卢克，这样做的目的是什么？

sentences.en: Because a great deal of this story and even Trump's role in it seems to have been told over the past year.
sentences.zh: 因为过去一年里，这个故事的很大一部分，甚至包括特朗普在其中的角色，似乎已经被讲述过了。

sentences.en: So there are probably a couple of goals for the committee depending on which committee member it is.
sentences.zh: 所以委员会可能有几个目标，具体取决于成员是谁。

sentences.en: I think for the vice chairwoman of the committee, Liz Cheney, and for Adam Kinzinger, the other Republican on the committee,
sentences.zh: 我认为对于委员会副主席利兹·切尼，以及委员会中另一位共和党人亚当·金辛格来说，

sentences.en: their goal is to try to excise Trump from the party once and for all.
sentences.zh: 他们的目标是试图将特朗普彻底从党内清除出去。

sentences.en: To convince both the American people but also the members of their own party that we cannot follow this guy anymore and we're going to lay out exactly why.
sentences.zh: 不仅要说服美国人民，还要说服他们自己党内的成员，即我们不能再追随这个人了，我们要详细说明原因。

sentences.en: That's the goal from the Republicans on the committee.
sentences.zh: 这就是委员会中共和党人的目标。

sentences.en: What about the Democrats, the majority of people on the committee?
sentences.zh: 那么民主党人呢，也就是委员会中的多数派？

sentences.en: Well, they would say their goal is to get to the bottom of the facts.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们会说他们的目标是查明事实真相。

sentences.en: But there is a political goal here for Democrats writ large, I think.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，对于民主党人来说，这里还有一个更宏大的政治目标。

sentences.en: And that is to draw a contrast with the Republican Party, which fell under Donald Trump's spell and followed him and then contrast that with the things that their party's doing.
sentences.zh: 那就是与共和党形成鲜明对比，因为共和党曾受特朗普蛊惑并追随他，我们要将其与民主党正在做的事情进行对比。

sentences.en: So yes, there may be problems with the economy right now, but we didn't try to overthrow an election.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，现在经济可能存在问题，但我们并没有试图推翻选举。

sentences.en: And there's potentially one more goal, which is held by, I think, the majority of the Democrats and the Republicans on the committee.
sentences.zh: 而且可能还有一个目标，我认为这是委员会中大多数民主党人和共和党人共同持有的。

sentences.en: And that is that they are actually building a case that could be taken by the Justice Department and used for a criminal charge against Donald Trump or his top allies to hold them accountable for the violence of January 6th.
sentences.zh: 那就是他们实际上正在构建一个案件，可以提交给司法部，用于对唐纳德·特朗普或其核心盟友提起刑事指控，让他们为1月6日的暴力事件负责。

sentences.en: So basically, they're hoping that a couple people in particular are watching these hearings, including the Attorney General of the United States, Merrick Garland.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，他们希望有几个人能特别关注这些听证会，包括美国司法部长梅里克·加兰。

sentences.en: Yes, and we know that Merrick Garland said that he is and that his top prosecutors are.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们知道梅里克·加兰说过他正在关注，他的高级检察官们也在关注。

sentences.en: So they are following this case very closely.
sentences.zh: 所以他们正在非常密切地跟踪这个案件。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Okay, so let's talk about how the committee has constructed these hearings to do all the things that you just laid out.
sentences.zh: 好的，那我们来谈谈委员会是如何构建这些听证会来完成你刚才提到的所有事情的。

sentences.en: Well, they have set up a series of hearings to try to have maximum impact.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们安排了一系列听证会，试图产生最大的影响力。

sentences.en: And the first thing they did was they scheduled their first hearing to be in prime time.
sentences.zh: 他们做的第一件事就是将首场听证会安排在黄金时段。

sentences.en: And they negotiated with the networks to carry it live.
sentences.zh: 并且他们与各大电视网协商进行直播。

sentences.en: And so I was at the Capitol for the first hearing and the select committee to investigate the January 6th attack on the United States Capitol will be in order.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时在国会大厦参加了第一场听证会，调查1月6日袭击美国国会大厦事件的特别委员会现在开会。

sentences.en: The hearing opens with Congressman Benny Thompson, who is the chairman of the committee.
sentences.zh: 听证会由委员会主席、国会议员本尼·汤普森开场。

sentences.en: Donald Trump lost the presidential election in 2020.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普在2020年总统大选中输了。

sentences.en: And I know as a reporter who's covered this very closely, one of the questions we all had in the press gallery at the time was,
sentences.zh: 作为一名密切报道此事的记者，我记得当时媒体席上的我们都有一个疑问：

sentences.en: would the committee actually discover things that were new, things we had not heard before?
sentences.zh: 委员会真的会发现一些新的东西吗，一些我们以前没听说过的事情？

sentences.en: Because we have, I think, uncovered a lot of things that happened in the buildup to January 6th.
sentences.zh: 因为我认为，我们已经揭露了很多在1月6日之前发生的事情。

sentences.en: And some of us were actually skeptical that they would be able to find anything that we didn't.
sentences.zh: 我们中有些人甚至怀疑他们是否能找到我们没发现的东西。

sentences.en: But right off the bat.
sentences.zh: 但一开始就有了。

sentences.en: It was not because of voter fraud.
sentences.zh: 这并不是因为选民欺诈。

sentences.en: Don't believe me?
sentences.zh: 不相信我吗？

sentences.en: Hear what his former attorney general had to say about it.
sentences.zh: 听听他前任司法部长是怎么说的。

sentences.en: Chairman Thompson plays a clip from an interview with former Attorney General Bill Barr.
sentences.zh: 汤普森主席播放了一段前司法部长比尔·巴尔的采访片段。

sentences.en: I had three discussions with the president that I can recall.
sentences.zh: 我记得我和总统有过三次讨论。

sentences.en: And Bill Barr recounts how he went in three times to tell Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 比尔·巴尔讲述了他三次去告诉唐纳德·特朗普的情景。

sentences.en: I made it clear I did not agree with the idea of saying the election was stolen and putting out this stuff, which I told the president was bullshit.
sentences.zh: 我明确表示，我不同意说选举被窃取并散布这些东西的说法，我告诉总统那是胡扯。

sentences.en: And I remember sitting up in the chair in the hearing room and thinking, oh, wow, they're really going to start bringing the goods here.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时坐在听证室的椅子上心想，哦，哇，他们真的要开始拿出真凭实据了。

sentences.en: He was the attorney general of the United States, the top law enforcement official in the country, telling the president exactly what he thought about claims of a stolen election.
sentences.zh: 他是美国的司法部长，是全国最高执法官员，他直接告诉总统他对所谓选举被窃取的看法。

sentences.en: And then Chairman Thompson turns the microphone over to it's my pleasure to recognize Ms. Cheney, the vice chairwoman.
sentences.zh: 然后汤普森主席把麦克风交给了副主席切尼女士，他说：我很荣幸请出副主席切尼女士。

sentences.en: Thank you very much, Mr. Chairman.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢，主席先生。

sentences.en: And let me ask you, Liz Cheney of Wyoming.
sentences.zh: 让我问问你，来自怀俄明州的利兹·切尼。

sentences.en: As you will see in the hearings to come, President Trump believed his supporters at the Capitol.
sentences.zh: 正如你们在接下来的听证会中将看到的，特朗普总统相信他在国会大厦的支持者们。

sentences.en: And I quote, we're doing what they should be doing.
sentences.zh: 引用他的话：他们正在做他们应该做的事。

sentences.en: And at a typical congressional hearing, this would be the time when the Republican starts to undercut what the Democrat has just said.
sentences.zh: 在典型的国会听证会上，这通常是共和党人开始反驳民主党人刚刚所说内容的时候。

sentences.en: And a fight sort of ensues at the dais.
sentences.zh: 主席台上通常会发生争吵。

sentences.en: Instead, President Trump summoned the mob, assembled the mob and lit the flame of this attack.
sentences.zh: 相反，特朗普总统召集了暴徒，集结了暴徒，并点燃了这次袭击的火焰。

sentences.en: She adopts a stance that's just as tough on Donald Trump, if not even tougher, than what Benny Thompson has just said.
sentences.zh: 她采取的立场对唐纳德·特朗普的态度同样强硬，甚至比本尼·汤普森刚才所说的还要强硬。

sentences.en: And it becomes very clear that the Republicans on the committee and the Democrats on the committee are in lockstep with condemning what Donald Trump did
sentences.zh: 很明显，委员会中的共和党人和民主党人步调一致，谴责唐纳德·特朗普的行为，

sentences.en: and detailing all of the evidence about how he tried to subvert an American election.
sentences.zh: 并详细列举了他试图颠覆美国选举的所有证据。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This was the moment for me, Luke, where it became clear that this hearing was going to be totally unlike any other congressional hearing we're used to seeing
sentences.zh: 对我来说，卢克，那一刻我清楚地意识到，这场听证会将与我们习惯看到的任何其他国会听证会完全不同，

sentences.en: because it was going to be uncluttered by all those interruptions and partisan bickerings that define a traditional congressional hearing
sentences.zh: 因为它不会被传统国会听证会中常见的那些干扰和党派争吵所打断，

sentences.en: and make it almost impossible to tell a single story.
sentences.zh: 那些干扰让讲述一个完整的故事变得几乎不可能。

sentences.en: Yes, I think very few people end up watching them.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想最终很少有人会去看那些听证会。

sentences.en: And instead, what we got was a very streamlined presentation where a really clear narrative could be told.
sentences.zh: 相反，我们看到的是一个非常精简的陈述，能够清晰地讲述一个完整的故事。

sentences.en: In our country, we don't swear an oath to an individual or a political party.
sentences.zh: 在我们的国家，我们不是对个人或政党宣誓。

sentences.en: We take our oath to defend the United States Constitution.
sentences.zh: 我们宣誓捍卫的是美国宪法。

sentences.en: And that oath must mean something.
sentences.zh: 而那个誓言必须有意义。

sentences.en: And then, as if to underscore that this was not going to be a traditional congressional hearing,
sentences.zh: 然后，仿佛为了强调这将不是一场传统的国会听证会，

sentences.en: Representative Cheney turned to the Trump wing of her party.
sentences.zh: 切尼众议员转向了她所在党派的特朗普派系。

sentences.en: Tonight, I say this to my Republican colleagues who are defending the indefensible.
sentences.zh: 今晚，我要对那些为不可辩护之事辩护的共和党同僚们说：

sentences.en: There will come a day when Donald Trump is gone, but your dishonor will remain.
sentences.zh: 终有一天唐纳德·特朗普会离开，但你们的耻辱将永远存在。

sentences.en: And drew a contrast between what she was doing on this committee and between what they had done, marching in lockstep with Donald Trump, lying about the election,
sentences.zh: 她将自己在这个委员会所做的事情与他们所做的事情进行了对比，他们曾与唐纳德·特朗普步调一致，在选举问题上撒谎，

sentences.en: and attempting to overturn an American election.
sentences.zh: 并试图推翻一场美国选举。

sentences.en: Over multiple months, Donald Trump oversaw and coordinated a sophisticated seven-part plan to overturn the presidential election and prevent the transfer of presidential power.
sentences.zh: 在几个月的时间里，唐纳德·特朗普监督并协调了一个复杂的七步计划，旨在推翻总统选举并阻止总统权力的移交。

sentences.en: And she describes what she calls a sophisticated seven-part plan to overturn the election.
sentences.zh: 她描述了她所称的推翻选举的复杂七步计划。

sentences.en: And that each one of these hearings would serve as its own chapter telling that part of the plan.
sentences.zh: 每一场听证会都将作为独立的一章，讲述该计划的一部分。

sentences.en: And it all begins with President Trump spreading the big lie.
sentences.zh: 这一切都始于特朗普总统散布“弥天大谎”。

sentences.en: In our second hearing, you will see that Donald Trump and his advisors knew that he had, in fact, lost the election.
sentences.zh: 在我们的第二场听证会上，你们将看到唐纳德·特朗普和他的顾问们知道他实际上已经输掉了选举。

sentences.en: But despite this, President Trump engaged in a massive effort to spread false and fraudulent information.
sentences.zh: 但尽管如此，特朗普总统还是进行了大规模的努力来散布虚假和欺诈性的信息。

sentences.en: Then he attempts to do different things to stay in power.
sentences.zh: 然后他试图采取各种手段来保住权力。

sentences.en: In the days before January 6th, President Trump told his top Justice Department officials, quote,
sentences.zh: 在1月6日之前的几天里，特朗普总统告诉他的高级司法部官员，引用他的话：

sentences.en: Just say the election was corrupt and leave the rest to me and the Republican congressman.
sentences.zh: 只要说选举是腐败的，剩下的交给我和共和党国会议员处理。

sentences.en: He tries to interfere with the Justice Department.
sentences.zh: 他试图干预司法部。

sentences.en: He tries to interfere with state officials.
sentences.zh: 他试图干预州政府官员。

sentences.en: As you will hear, President Trump engaged in a relentless effort to pressure Pence, both in private and in public.
sentences.zh: 正如你们将听到的，特朗普总统在私下和公开场合都对彭斯进行了无情的施压。

sentences.en: And then finally, when everything else fails.
sentences.zh: 最后，当其他一切都失败时。

sentences.en: In our final two June hearings, you will hear how President Trump summoned a violent mob and directed them illegally to march on the United States Capitol.
sentences.zh: 在我们6月份最后两场听证会上，你们将听到特朗普总统是如何召集暴力暴徒，并非法指挥他们向美国国会大厦进军的。

sentences.en: And as the crowd morphs into a mob, begins attacking the building and chanting,
sentences.zh: 当人群演变成暴徒，开始攻击大楼并高呼：

sentences.en: Hang Mike Pence, he does nothing for 187 minutes.
sentences.zh: 绞死迈克·彭斯时，他在187分钟内什么都没做。

sentences.en: Not only did President Trump refuse to tell the mob to leave the Capitol, he placed no call to any element of the United States government to instruct that the Capitol be defended.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统不仅拒绝告诉暴徒离开国会大厦，他也没有给美国政府的任何部门打过一个电话，指示保卫国会大厦。

sentences.en: He did not call his secretary of defense.
sentences.zh: 他没有给他的国防部长打电话。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And in a way, she's laying out what starts to feel, because this is, after all, a televised set of hearings, a kind of serialized TV show about January 6th.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，她所展示的内容开始让人感觉——因为这毕竟是一系列电视转播的听证会——就像是一部关于1月6日的系列电视剧。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So you can think of that first hearing as almost like a pilot episode of a television show.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以把第一场听证会看作是电视剧的试播集。

sentences.en: The select committee to investigate the January 6th attack on the United States Capitol will be in order.
sentences.zh: 调查1月6日袭击美国国会大厦事件的特别委员会现在开会。

sentences.en: And now they're going to take you to the second episode.
sentences.zh: 现在他们要带你进入第二集。

sentences.en: This morning, we'll tell the story of how Donald Trump lost an election and knew he lost an election.
sentences.zh: 今天上午，我们将讲述唐纳德·特朗普如何输掉选举，以及他如何知道自己输掉选举的故事。

sentences.en: And that is how Trump began lying about the election and start to show you the damage and the havoc those lies caused.
sentences.zh: 这就是特朗普如何开始在选举问题上撒谎，并开始向你们展示这些谎言造成的破坏和浩劫。

sentences.en: Pay attention to what Donald Trump and his legal team said repeatedly about Dominion voting machines.
sentences.zh: 注意唐纳德·特朗普和他的法律团队反复提到的关于Dominion投票机的事情。

sentences.en: Far-flung conspiracies with a deceased Venezuelan communist allegedly pulling the strings.
sentences.zh: 那些荒谬的阴谋论，甚至声称有一个已故的委内瑞拉共产主义者在幕后操纵。

sentences.en: Probably the most important thing we learned was that some of Donald Trump's top advisors told Donald Trump that what he was saying about the election was false.
sentences.zh: 我们了解到的最重要的事情可能是，唐纳德·特朗普的一些高级顾问告诉他，他关于选举的言论是虚假的。

sentences.en: Here, for example, is White House lawyer Eric Hirschman.
sentences.zh: 例如，这里是白宫律师埃里克·赫什曼。

sentences.en: His view was shared by many of the Trump team whom we interviewed.
sentences.zh: 他的观点被我们采访过的许多特朗普团队成员所认同。

sentences.en: I thought the Dominion stuff was, I never saw any evidence whatsoever to sustain those allegations.
sentences.zh: 我认为Dominion的事情……我从未见过任何证据来支持这些指控。

sentences.en: He is told again and again that there is no fraud.
sentences.zh: 他一次又一次地被告知没有欺诈行为。

sentences.en: And I said something to the effect of, sir, we've done dozens of investigations, hundreds of interviews.
sentences.zh: 我说过类似这样的话：先生，我们已经进行了几十次调查，几百次访谈。

sentences.en: The major allegations are not supported by the evidence developed.
sentences.zh: 主要的指控并没有得到所收集证据的支持。

sentences.en: We've looked at Georgia, Pennsylvania, Michigan, Nevada.
sentences.zh: 我们调查了佐治亚州、宾夕法尼亚州、密歇根州、内华达州。

sentences.en: We're doing our job.
sentences.zh: 我们正在履行我们的职责。

sentences.en: Much of the info you're getting is false.
sentences.zh: 你得到的大部分信息都是虚假的。

sentences.en: Then the committee once again turns to former Attorney General Bill Barr.
sentences.zh: 然后委员会再次转向前司法部长比尔·巴尔。

sentences.en: There was an avalanche of all these allegations of fraud that built up over a number of days.
sentences.zh: 在几天的时间里，出现了大量的欺诈指控。

sentences.en: And it was like playing whack-a-mole because something would come out one day and then the next day it would be another issue.
sentences.zh: 这就像在玩打地鼠游戏，因为今天冒出一个问题，第二天又会出现另一个问题。

sentences.en: And they play another clip of his deposition.
sentences.zh: 他们播放了另一段他的证词录像。

sentences.en: When I walked in, sat down, he went off on a monologue.
sentences.zh: 当我走进去坐下时，他开始滔滔不绝地独白。

sentences.en: In which he describes how he again went into Donald Trump to talk to him about the election results.
sentences.zh: 在独白中，他描述了自己是如何再次去见唐纳德·特朗普，与他谈论选举结果的。

sentences.en: And I was somewhat demoralized because I thought, boy, if he really believes this stuff, he has, you know, lost contact with, with, he's become detached from reality.
sentences.zh: 我感到有些沮丧，因为我想，天哪，如果他真的相信这些东西，他已经，你知道，失去了与现实的联系，他已经脱离现实了。

sentences.en: And as Bill Barr is describing the type of things that Donald Trump believes or was telling people to the committee.
sentences.zh: 当比尔·巴尔向委员会描述唐纳德·特朗普相信或告诉人们的那些事情时，

sentences.en: There was never an indication of interest in what the actual facts were.
sentences.zh: 他从未表现出对事实真相的兴趣。

sentences.en: He breaks out into laughter because the allegations that are being made are so absurd.
sentences.zh: 他突然大笑起来，因为这些指控实在太荒谬了。

sentences.en: I mean, they include Hugo Chavez flipping votes.
sentences.zh: 我是说，它们竟然包括查韦斯操纵选票。

sentences.en: Hugo Chavez has been dead since 2013.
sentences.zh: 查韦斯自2013年以来就已经去世了。

sentences.en: They involve people in Italy, defense contractors flipping votes, using satellites.
sentences.zh: 它们还涉及意大利人、国防承包商利用卫星操纵选票。

sentences.en: And they involve schemes involving China and thermometers and voting booths.
sentences.zh: 它们还涉及涉及中国、温度计和投票站的阴谋。

sentences.en: I mean, they become so absurd, they become laughable.
sentences.zh: 我是说，它们变得如此荒谬，简直可笑。

sentences.en: But what's not funny is that hundreds of Donald Trump supporters believe these lies, became so enraged by them, and stormed the Capitol, injuring people in a deadly riot.
sentences.zh: 但不可笑的是，成百上千的唐纳德·特朗普支持者相信了这些谎言，被激怒，并冲击了国会大厦，在致命的骚乱中伤害了他人。

sentences.en: And so at that point, it's not funny anymore.
sentences.zh: 所以在那一刻，这不再可笑了。

sentences.en: It's deadly serious.
sentences.zh: 这是极其严肃的。

sentences.en: — Luke, why is the committee trying so hard in this hearing to show that the people around the president are telling him that he's wrong, and then that he contravenes them anyway?
sentences.zh: ——卢克，为什么委员会在这场听证会上如此努力地证明总统身边的人都在告诉他错了，而他却依然一意孤行？

sentences.en: — Well, it shows that Donald Trump knew or should have known that what he was saying was a lie.
sentences.zh: ——嗯，这表明唐纳德·特朗普知道或者应该知道他所说的是谎言。

sentences.en: And that gets to intent.
sentences.zh: 这涉及到了意图。

sentences.en: And intent is key to fraud.
sentences.zh: 而意图是欺诈的关键。

sentences.en: And the committee has alleged in court papers that there was a conspiracy to commit fraud involving Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 委员会在法庭文件中指控唐纳德·特朗普参与了欺诈阴谋。

sentences.en: And the fraud was perpetrated on the American public.
sentences.zh: 而这种欺诈行为是针对美国公众实施的。

sentences.en: — So if a prosecutor is one day going to take this case, they will want to know that he knew, or at least should have known, that what he was saying was a lie.
sentences.zh: ——所以如果有一天检察官要接手这个案子，他们会想知道他是否知道，或者至少应该知道，他所说的是谎言。

sentences.en: So to the extent the committee can document every time, every person, as the numbers multiply,
sentences.zh: 因此，委员会记录的次数越多，涉及的人数越多，

sentences.en: who told Donald Trump that what he was saying was false, but Donald Trump kept saying it anyway, it bolsters the case that this was, in fact, fraud.
sentences.zh: 那些告诉唐纳德·特朗普他的言论是虚假的人，而特朗普却依然坚持这么说，这越能加强这是一个欺诈行为的论点。

sentences.en: — Mr. Chairman, at this time, I'd ask for unanimous consent to include in the record a video presentation describing how President Trump used the lies he told
sentences.zh: — 主席先生，此时此刻，我请求一致同意将一份视频演示记录在案，该视频描述了特朗普总统如何利用他所说的谎言

sentences.en: to raise millions of dollars from the American people.
sentences.zh: 从美国人民手中筹集了数百万美元。

sentences.en: — And then they used this fraud to take their case to the next step, and that is fundraising.
sentences.zh: — 然后他们利用这种欺诈手段将他们的主张推进到下一步，那就是筹款。

sentences.en: And so the committee begins laying out, towards the end of the second hearing, just how much money Donald Trump and his allies raised from their supporters based on the lie
sentences.zh: 因此，在第二次听证会临近结束时，委员会开始披露唐纳德·特朗普及其盟友基于选举被窃取的谎言

sentences.en: of a stolen election.
sentences.zh: 从他们的支持者那里筹集了多少钱。

sentences.en: And they come up with the figure $250 million.
sentences.zh: 他们得出的数字是2.5亿美元。

sentences.en: — Wow.
— Yes.
sentences.zh: — 是的。

sentences.en: And that's an astonishing number, because usually at the end of a campaign, for the losing candidate, the money dries up.
sentences.zh: 这是一个惊人的数字，因为通常在竞选结束时，对于落选的候选人来说，资金来源就会枯竭。

sentences.en: Nobody wants to give their money to a loser.
sentences.zh: 没人愿意把钱给一个失败者。

sentences.en: There's no point to it.
sentences.zh: 这样做毫无意义。

sentences.en: It doesn't go anywhere.
sentences.zh: 这钱根本没处花。

sentences.en: But what happens here is Donald Trump and his allies realize that by lying about the election, they can keep the money flowing in.
sentences.zh: 但这里发生的情况是，唐纳德·特朗普及其盟友意识到，通过在选举问题上撒谎，他们可以保持资金源源不断地流入。

sentences.en: And so after he loses on election day, millions of dollars flow into the Trump campaign.
sentences.zh: 因此，在他选举日落败后，数百万美元流入了特朗普的竞选团队。

sentences.en: — We found evidence that the Trump campaign and its surrogates misled donors as to where their funds would go and what they would be used for.
sentences.zh: — 我们发现有证据表明，特朗普竞选团队及其代理人在资金去向和用途上误导了捐赠者。

sentences.en: — And what that money is supposed to go to, they tell voters it will go to a fund to fight the election results.
sentences.zh: — 他们告诉选民，这些钱应该进入一个旨在挑战选举结果的基金。

sentences.en: — I don't believe there is actually a fund called the Election Defense Fund.
sentences.zh: — 我不相信真的有一个叫“选举防御基金”的基金存在。

sentences.en: — But it was revealed in testimony at the second hearing that that fund did not exiSt.
sentences.zh: — 但在第二次听证会的证词中披露，该基金并不存在。

sentences.en: — Is it for you to say that the Election Defense Fund was another, I think we've called it a marketing tactic?
sentences.zh: — 您是否认为“选举防御基金”只是另一个，我想我们称之为营销策略的东西？

sentences.en: — Yes.
sentences.zh: — 是的。

sentences.en: — And so in fact, the money went to a super PAC created by Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: — 事实上，这笔钱流向了唐纳德·特朗普创建的一个超级政治行动委员会（Super PAC）。

sentences.en: — And that money was then dispersed to Trump allies.
sentences.zh: — 而这笔钱随后被分发给了特朗普的盟友。

sentences.en: $200,000 went to Trump hotels.
sentences.zh: 20万美元流向了特朗普旗下的酒店。

sentences.en: $5 million went to the company that put on the rally that preceded the riot.
sentences.zh: 500万美元流向了举办骚乱前集会的公司。

sentences.en: So lots of people were getting paid out of this money, but none of it was actually going to a defense fund for the election.
sentences.zh: 所以很多人都从这笔钱中拿到了报酬，但实际上没有一分钱用于选举防御基金。

sentences.en: And Congresswoman Zoe Lofgren had a way of saying it.
sentences.zh: 佐伊·洛夫格伦众议员对此有独特的说法。

sentences.en: — So not only was there the big lie, there was the big ripoff.
sentences.zh: — 所以不仅有“弥天大谎”，还有“弥天大骗”。

sentences.en: Donors deserve to know where their funds are really going.
sentences.zh: 捐赠者有权知道他们的资金到底去了哪里。

sentences.en: They deserve better than what President Trump and his team did.
sentences.zh: 他们理应得到比特朗普总统及其团队所做的更好的对待。

sentences.en: Mr. Chairman, I yield back.
sentences.zh: 主席先生，我发言完毕。

sentences.en: — So this testimony is showing fraud on various levels.
sentences.zh: — 所以这些证词显示了各个层面的欺诈。

sentences.en: There's the fraud, in theory, that Trump is committing in lying to the public about the election results.
sentences.zh: 理论上，特朗普在选举结果问题上对公众撒谎构成了欺诈。

sentences.en: And then there's the fraud in asking them to give money to try to overturn the election, but then that money being used for other purposes.
sentences.zh: 此外，他要求人们捐款以试图推翻选举，但这些钱却被挪作他用，这也是欺诈。

sentences.en: — Yes.
sentences.zh: — 是的。

sentences.en: And the committee believes that this might be a key way to break through to Republicans about what Donald Trump did to their party and to the country.
sentences.zh: 委员会认为，这可能是让共和党人认清唐纳德·特朗普对他们的党派和国家所作所为的关键突破口。

sentences.en: That it's one thing for Republicans to hear him say the election was stolen, but it's another thing to have him then dupe his donors to break with their hard-earned money
sentences.zh: 共和党人听到他说选举被窃取是一回事，但让他诱骗捐赠者掏出辛苦赚来的钱，

sentences.en: and give it to him when it was all a con.
sentences.zh: 并在这一切都是骗局的情况下把钱交给他，则是另一回事。

sentences.en: — So look, at this point, how are these two hearings, the pilot, as you called it, and this first episode that really delves into the question of the big lie,
sentences.zh: — 那么，在这一点上，这两场听证会——你所说的试点，以及深入探讨“弥天大谎”问题的这一第一集，

sentences.en: how are they starting to land?
sentences.zh: 它们开始产生什么影响了吗？

sentences.en: — Well, the committee set out to establish that Donald Trump was at the center of the plot to overturn the election.
sentences.zh: — 嗯，委员会旨在确立唐纳德·特朗普是推翻选举阴谋的核心人物。

sentences.en: That this wasn't the case where the president got misled by a rogue advisor, or he had bad data that he was reading,
sentences.zh: 这并非总统被流氓顾问误导，或者他阅读了错误的数据，

sentences.en: or he watched too much of a certain television channel and was fooled.
sentences.zh: 或者他看了太多某个电视频道而被愚弄的情况。

sentences.en: He was the origin of saying the election was stolen so he could stay in power.
sentences.zh: 他才是宣称选举被窃取的始作俑者，目的是为了保住权力。

sentences.en: And he was impervious to advisor after advisor telling him to stop.
sentences.zh: 而且无论顾问们如何劝阻，他都充耳不闻。

sentences.en: And so that brings us to the natural outgrowth of those lies for Donald Trump, which is as he's trying to stay in power, as he's spreading the big lie,
sentences.zh: 这自然引出了唐纳德·特朗普这些谎言的后续影响，即当他试图保住权力、散布弥天大谎时，

sentences.en: he's running out of options to stay in office.
sentences.zh: 他留在职位的选择已经不多了。

sentences.en: And so finally, he settles on probably the most audacious strategy yet, and that is to pressure his own vice president, Mike Pence,
sentences.zh: 最终，他选择了迄今为止最大胆的策略，那就是向他自己的副总统迈克·彭斯施压，

sentences.en: to throw out legitimate votes when Congress meets on January 6th and install Donald Trump for a second term.
sentences.zh: 要求他在1月6日国会开会时否决合法的选票，并让唐纳德·特朗普连任。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、

sentences.en: Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 齐尔兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 您可以实时观看其中一些毫无保留、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日通过nytimes.com直播精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻报道的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望您能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: So, Luke, what does the committee reveal about this next stage of what they're calling
sentences.zh: 那么，卢克，委员会揭露了他们所称的下一阶段的什么内容？

sentences.en: Trump's conspiracy, his effort to try to use his vice president to overturn the election?
sentences.zh: 特朗普的阴谋，即他试图利用副总统推翻选举的努力？

sentences.en: Well, Michael, that's the focus of the third hearing, which took place Thursday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 嗯，迈克尔，这就是周四下午举行的第三场听证会的焦点。

sentences.en: Good afternoon.
sentences.zh: 下午好。

sentences.en: Today, we'll lay out the facts for the American people.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们将向美国人民陈述事实。

sentences.en: And what the committee is able to detail is the pressure campaign against Mike Pence.
sentences.zh: 委员会能够详细说明的是针对迈克·彭斯的施压行动。

sentences.en: Donald Trump tried three, four, five different ways to stay in power, pressuring state officials, intervening with the Justice Department.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普尝试了三、四、五种不同的方式来保住权力，包括向州官员施压，干预司法部。

sentences.en: And he's running out of options.
sentences.zh: 他的选择已经不多了。

sentences.en: He needs to come up with something.
sentences.zh: 他必须想出点办法。

sentences.en: President Trump plotted with a lawyer named John Eastman.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统与一位名叫约翰·伊斯特曼的律师密谋。

sentences.en: And a conservative attorney named John Eastman comes onto his radar.
sentences.zh: 一位名叫约翰·伊斯特曼的保守派律师进入了他的视野。

sentences.en: Eastman was at the time a law professor at Chapman University Law School.
sentences.zh: 伊斯特曼当时是查普曼大学法学院的法学教授。

sentences.en: And tells him things that Donald Trump wants to hear.
sentences.zh: 他告诉唐纳德·特朗普想听的话。

sentences.en: He prepared a memo outlining the nonsensical theory that the vice president could decide the outcome of the election at the joint session of Congress on January 6th.
sentences.zh: 他准备了一份备忘录，概述了一个荒谬的理论，即副总统可以在1月6日国会联席会议上决定选举结果。

sentences.en: And that is, he could exploit federal law when Congress meets on January 6th.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，他可以在1月6日国会开会时利用联邦法律。

sentences.en: Here, Dr. Eastman says the vice president can reject the Biden electors from the states that he calls, quote, disputed.
sentences.zh: 在这里，伊斯特曼博士说副总统可以拒绝来自他所谓的“有争议”州的拜登选举人。

sentences.en: And invoke powers never before assumed by a vice president to throw out legitimate votes from the states
sentences.zh: 并援引副总统从未行使过的权力，否决来自各州的合法选票，

sentences.en: and accept a slate of fake electors for Donald Trump to install him for a second term.
sentences.zh: 并接受唐纳德·特朗普的虚假选举人名单，以让他连任。

sentences.en: This is something that never before has been tried in modern American history.
sentences.zh: 这是现代美国历史上从未尝试过的事情。

sentences.en: It is a plan so audacious that almost everyone who hears it right away rejects it as illegal.
sentences.zh: 这是一个如此大胆的计划，以至于几乎所有听到它的人都会立即将其斥为非法。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And those are the people who end up testifying before the committee.
sentences.zh: 而这些人最终都在委员会面前作证了。

sentences.en: That's correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Mr. Jacob, how did this theory first come to your attention?
sentences.zh: 雅各布先生，这个理论最初是如何引起您注意的？

sentences.en: One of the committee's main witnesses was Mike Pence's top lawyer, a man named Greg Jacob.
sentences.zh: 委员会的主要证人之一是迈克·彭斯的首席律师，一个名叫格雷格·雅各布的人。

sentences.en: The first time that I had a conversation with the vice president about the 12th Amendment and the Electoral Count Act was in early December.
sentences.zh: 我第一次与副总统讨论第12修正案和《选举计票法》是在12月初。

sentences.en: And he testified that Pence right away knew that this was wrong and un-American.
sentences.zh: 他作证说，彭斯立刻就知道这是错误的，是不符合美国精神的。

sentences.en: The vice president's first instinct when he heard this theory was that there was no way
sentences.zh: 副总统听到这个理论时的第一直觉是，我们的开国元勋们摆脱了乔治三世的暴政，

sentences.en: that our framers who had broken away from the tyranny of George III would ever have put one person in a role to have decisive impact on the outcome of the election.

sentences.zh: 在这样做的时候，委员会也推进了另一个战略目标。

sentences.en: And that is to excise Donald Trump from the Republican Party and from American politics altogether.
sentences.zh: 那就是将唐纳德·特朗普彻底从共和党和美国政治中剔除出去。

sentences.en: And they want to get that through to the voters, because many of the voters on the right are still with Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 他们想让选民明白这一点，因为右翼的许多选民仍然支持唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: And so they're going to make this case, but they're going to make it, for the most part, using Republican voices.
sentences.zh: 所以他们要提出这个论点，但他们主要会利用共和党人的声音来提出。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So finally, Luke, there's the question of impact and whether these hearings are succeeding.
sentences.zh: 最后，卢克，还有一个关于影响力和这些听证会是否成功的问题。

sentences.en: And that feels like a fair question to ask, as we've now got three of them under our belt.
sentences.zh: 作为一个公平的问题，我们现在已经进行了三场听证会。

sentences.en: So I'm curious, how are you trying to gauge that, if the January 6th televised hearings are breaking through?
sentences.zh: 所以我很好奇，如果1月6日的电视听证会正在产生影响，你打算如何衡量这一点？

sentences.en: Well, there are a number of ways to look at that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有很多方法可以观察这一点。

sentences.en: One, you could look at television ratings.
sentences.zh: 第一，你可以看看电视收视率。

sentences.en: The very first hearing attracted more than 20 million viewers.
sentences.zh: 第一场听证会吸引了超过2000万观众。

sentences.en: And that is an astonishingly high number for a congressional hearing.
sentences.zh: 对于国会听证会来说，这是一个惊人的高数字。

sentences.en: The second is you saw a shift in some of the major media outlets on the right in how they were going to approach these hearings.
sentences.zh: 第二，你看到一些右翼主流媒体在对待这些听证会的方式上发生了转变。

sentences.en: Fox News, which refused to carry the first hearing, changed course.
sentences.zh: 拒绝转播第一场听证会的福克斯新闻改变了方针。

sentences.en: And they began airing the second and third hearings.
sentences.zh: 他们开始播出第二场和第三场听证会。

sentences.en: You saw a couple of the most influential newspapers on the right editorialize after the first hearing against Donald Trump, which struck me as pretty notable.
sentences.zh: 你看到右翼几家最有影响力的报纸在第一场听证会后发表社论反对唐纳德·特朗普，这让我觉得非常引人注目。

sentences.en: And then third, I've noticed a sort of lack of what was promised to be a rapid response from the right.
sentences.zh: 第三，我注意到右翼承诺的所谓快速反应似乎缺乏力度。

sentences.en: And I noticed that especially after this last hearing.
sentences.zh: 我特别是在最后一场听证会后注意到了这一点。

sentences.en: And that's because how can you attack Mike Pence if you're on the right?
sentences.zh: 这是因为如果你是右翼，你怎么能攻击迈克·彭斯呢？

sentences.en: If you believe in constitutional conservatism, what do you say when it's Mike Pence making the case that what Donald Trump did was wrong?
sentences.zh: 如果你信仰宪法保守主义，当迈克·彭斯指出唐纳德·特朗普所做的是错误的时候，你该说什么？

sentences.en: And so I think big picture,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为从大局来看，

sentences.en: the committee is building an effective case that it wasn't just Democrats who were victims of Donald Trump's pressure campaign to stay in office and overturn the election.
sentences.zh: 委员会正在建立一个有效的论点，即不仅民主党人是唐纳德·特朗普为了留任和推翻选举而进行的施压运动的受害者。

sentences.en: It was Republicans, too.
sentences.zh: 共和党人也是。

sentences.en: They're trying to show that Donald Trump turned on his own voters.
sentences.zh: 他们试图表明唐纳德·特朗普背叛了自己的选民。

sentences.en: He took their money, and then he created a situation where their own vice president was in danger, and he didn't seem to care.
sentences.zh: 他拿了他们的钱，然后制造了一个让他们的副总统处于危险之中的局面，而他似乎并不在乎。

sentences.en: Well, Luke, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，卢克，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: The next televised hearing of the January 6th committee will be held on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 1月6日委员会的下一场电视听证会将于周二举行。

sentences.en: It will focus on another target of Trump's efforts to overturn the election.
sentences.zh: 它将聚焦于特朗普推翻选举努力的另一个目标。

sentences.zh: 州官员。

sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。
